boards.title: Your First Weekend at Swarthmore College, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key, under-21-safe sequence of named campus places for getting oriented, spending time outdoors, finding culture, and settling into the weekend.

cards.title: Start with the Visitor’s Center
cards.subtitle: Friday arrival • Benjamin West House
cards.notes: Begin here to orient yourself, then use the campus map to choose a walking route before heading toward the academic core.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed starting point for finding your bearings on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The College’s campus map lists the Visitor’s Center in Benjamin West House.
cards.access_notes: Confirm visitor services and building access before arrival.

cards.title: Walk to Parrish Hall
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • campus center
cards.notes: Use Parrish Hall as a clear landmark while you learn the main paths; pause outside and identify nearby destinations on the map.
cards.short_summary: A named campus landmark that anchors an initial orientation walk.
cards.evidence_claim: The College’s campus map lists Parrish Hall and its Admissions and Dean’s Office locations.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor viewing is the simplest option; building access may vary.

cards.title: Take an Arboretum walk
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • campus gardens
cards.notes: Choose a short garden walk, read plant labels, and make this your daylight reset before moving on to indoor campus spaces.
cards.short_summary: A public campus landscape with labeled plants and seasonal interest.
cards.evidence_claim: Swarthmore describes its campus as a designated arboretum with gardens and rolling lawns.
cards.access_notes: Enjoy the outdoor grounds respectfully and follow posted garden guidance.

cards.title: Find the outdoor amphitheater
cards.subtitle: Friday afternoon • near the Arboretum
cards.notes: Continue to the amphitheater for a quick look at a distinctive campus landscape; keep the visit to open public paths and seating areas.
cards.short_summary: A named outdoor campus venue set among mature trees.
cards.evidence_claim: The Crum Woods trail map identifies the Scott Outdoor Amphitheater and says it hosts the College’s annual commencement exercises.
cards.access_notes: Use only open outdoor areas; event setup can limit access.

cards.title: See what’s on at List Gallery
cards.subtitle: Saturday midday • Lang Performing Arts Center
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition before you go, then visit during posted hours and use the gallery as a calm, indoor art stop.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus gallery in the Lang Performing Arts Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The College says List Gallery is on the first floor of LPAC and posts Tuesday–Sunday hours of noon–5 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are Tuesday–Sunday, noon–5 p.m.; verify exhibition dates before visiting.

cards.title: Locate McCabe Library
cards.subtitle: Saturday afternoon • library stop
cards.notes: Make a first pass through McCabe to identify service desks and study areas, then save a convenient spot for a future reading session.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed library destination at the heart of campus resources.
cards.evidence_claim: The College’s campus map lists McCabe Library and the Friends Historical Library and Peace Collection within it.
cards.access_notes: Check current library entry and service hours before planning an extended visit.

cards.title: Plan a meal at Sharples
cards.subtitle: Saturday evening • Dining Hall
cards.notes: Use the campus dining listing to plan a meal break, and check current dining information for menu, eligibility, and service details.
cards.short_summary: The College’s main campus cafeteria for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.
cards.evidence_claim: Swarthmore identifies the Dining Center as its main campus cafeteria and lists breakfast, lunch, and dinner service.
cards.access_notes: Dining access and payment requirements can vary; consult Swarthmore Dining before visiting.

cards.title: Walk a Crum Woods trail
cards.subtitle: Sunday daylight • trails by Crum Creek
cards.notes: Pick a daylight trail walk, stay on marked routes, leave no trace, and turn back well before dark so you can return comfortably.
cards.short_summary: A large campus woodland with walking trails and a creek.
cards.evidence_claim: The College’s trail map says Crum Woods has roughly 3.5 miles of walking trails and is open to visitors from sunup to sundown.
cards.access_notes: Open sunup to sundown; visitors proceed at their own risk and should leave no trace.

cards.entity_name: Lang Music Building and Concert Hall
cards.title: Find the concert hall
cards.subtitle: Sunday afternoon • arts landmark
cards.notes: Add the Lang Music Building to your campus mental map, then review official event listings later when choosing a performance to attend.
cards.short_summary: A named campus music and performance destination.
cards.evidence_claim: The College’s campus map lists the Lang Music Building and Concert Hall, along with the Underhill Music and Dance Library.
cards.access_notes: Concert attendance, ticketing, and building access depend on the specific event.

cards.title: End by locating the station
cards.subtitle: Sunday evening • campus edge
cards.notes: Walk to the station in daylight to understand the route between campus and town, then check SEPTA directly before any future trip.
cards.short_summary: A map-listed transit landmark at the edge of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The College’s campus map lists the Train Station (SEPTA) as a campus destination.
cards.access_notes: Check current SEPTA schedules, fares, and platform information before traveling.
